record.original_question: Does every homogeneous structure with finite big Ramsey degrees admit a big Ramsey structure, and is there an exact analogue of the Kechris-Pestov-Todorcevic correspondence that links big Ramsey structures with the topological dynamics of automorphism groups?

evidence.quote: Problem 6.3. Does every homogeneous structure with finite big Ramsey degrees also carry a big Ramsey structure? Is there an exact correspondence, in the vein of the KPT-correspondence, between big Ramsey structures and topological dynamics?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions.

Let $\mathcal{K}$ be a Fraïssé class of finite structures in a countable relational language and let $\mathbf{K}$ be its Fraïssé limit, a countable homogeneous structure. For finite substructures $\mathbf{A} \subseteq \mathbf{K}$, let $\binom{\mathbf{K}}{\mathbf{A}}$ denote the set of isomorphic copies of $\mathbf{A}$ in $\mathbf{K}$. The big Ramsey degree of $\mathbf{A}$ in $\mathbf{K}$ is the least integer $T(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{K}) \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$ such that for every finite coloring $c : \binom{\mathbf{K}}{\mathbf{A}} \to r$ (with $r \in \mathbb{N}$) there exists a copy $\mathbf{K}' \subseteq \mathbf{K}$ of $\mathbf{K}$ on which $c$ takes at most $T(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{K})$ values. We say $\mathbf{K}$ has finite big Ramsey degrees if $T(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{K}) < \infty$ for every finite $\mathbf{A} \subseteq \mathbf{K}$.

A big Ramsey structure for $\mathbf{K}$ is an expansion $\mathbf{K}^*$ of $\mathbf{K}$ in a countable relational language extending that of $\mathbf{K}$, such that:
(i) the age of $\mathbf{K}^*$ is a Fraïssé class with finitely many expansions of each finite structure in $\mathcal{K}$;
(ii) for every finite $\mathbf{A} \subseteq \mathbf{K}$, the number of isomorphism types of expansions $\mathbf{A}^*$ realised on copies of $\mathbf{A}$ in $\mathbf{K}^*$ equals $T(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{K})$;
(iii) for every coloring of $\binom{\mathbf{K}}{\mathbf{A}}$ by isomorphism types of expansion, there is a copy of $\mathbf{K}$ in $\mathbf{K}^*$ on which all copies of $\mathbf{A}$ realise the same expansion type, and this number $T(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{K})$ cannot be reduced further.

The Kechris–Pestov–Todorčević (KPT) correspondence states that, for a Fraïssé limit $\mathbf{K}$ in a countable relational language, the class $\mathrm{Age}(\mathbf{K})$ has the Ramsey property and consists of rigid structures if and only if $\mathrm{Aut}(\mathbf{K})$ is extremely amenable; more generally, finite small Ramsey degrees correspond to metrizability of the universal minimal flow $M(\mathrm{Aut}(\mathbf{K}))$, and the universal minimal flow can be computed explicitly from a precompact relational expansion satisfying the expansion property and the Ramsey property.

Problem.

(a) Does every countable homogeneous structure $\mathbf{K}$ with finite big Ramsey degrees admit a big Ramsey structure in the sense above?

(b) Establish an exact analogue of the KPT correspondence linking big Ramsey structures of $\mathbf{K}$ with the topological dynamics of $\mathrm{Aut}(\mathbf{K})$: identify a canonical dynamical object (for instance, a completion-type flow on the space of big Ramsey expansions) whose properties are equivalent to $\mathbf{K}$ having a big Ramsey structure, in the same way that extreme amenability and metrizability of the universal minimal flow correspond to small Ramsey-theoretic properties.
artifact.category_tag: big Ramsey structures and topological dynamics
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears to remain open. A 2024 survey on big Ramsey structures by Hubička and Zucker discusses this question and provides partial results showing that standard methods of proving finite big Ramsey degrees often yield big Ramsey structures, but a general equivalence and a full topological-dynamical analogue of the KPT correspondence are not established. Recent literature continues to treat both the existence question and the dynamical correspondence as outstanding research problems.

status_evidence.title: A survey on big Ramsey structures
status_evidence.snippet: The first half of a survey collects facts about big Ramsey structures into a cohesive framework and presents original results indicating that standard methods of proving finite big Ramsey degrees automatically yield big Ramsey structures.
status_evidence.claim: The general question whether finite big Ramsey degrees imply existence of a big Ramsey structure is still being addressed via partial results, indicating it is open in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Ramsey theory of homogeneous structures: current trends and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems on big Ramsey degrees including the dynamical analogue of the KPT correspondence.
status_evidence.claim: The exact KPT-style correspondence for big Ramsey structures is listed among current open problems.

status_evidence.title: Big Ramsey degrees and topological dynamics (Zucker)
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces big Ramsey structures and partial dynamical correspondence.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial KPT-style links but not a full equivalence.
